quests.instruction: Which person sits behind the wheel and controls a car or bus?
quests.question: Driver
quests.hint: Think about the person who steers, brakes, and decides which way the car goes.
quests.explanation: A driver is a person who controls a vehicle. Drivers steer and operate cars, buses, and trucks!
quests.funFact: A driver must learn and pass a test before they are allowed to drive on their own!

quests.instruction: Which person sits in the cockpit and flies an airplane?
quests.question: Pilot
quests.hint: Think about the person in the front seat of a plane who controls it through the sky.
quests.explanation: A pilot is a person who flies an airplane. Pilots train for years to fly safely!
quests.funFact: A pilot checks dozens of instruments before every single flight to make sure everything is ready!

quests.instruction: Which person is in charge of a ship and makes sure the whole crew works together?
quests.question: Captain
quests.hint: Think about the person in charge of a whole ship, giving directions to the entire crew.
quests.explanation: A captain is the person in charge of a ship. Captains make sure the crew and ship travel safely!
quests.funFact: A ship's captain is responsible for the safety of everyone traveling on board!

quests.instruction: Which person checks tickets and helps passengers on a train?
quests.question: Conductor
quests.hint: Think about the person who walks through a train checking tickets and answering questions.
quests.explanation: A conductor is a person who checks tickets on a train. Conductors help passengers during their trip!
quests.funFact: A conductor also helps signal when it is time for a train to safely leave the station!

quests.instruction: Which person rides in a vehicle without driving or steering it themselves?
quests.question: Passenger
quests.hint: Think about the person sitting comfortably in a seat while someone else does the driving.
quests.explanation: A passenger is a person who rides without driving. Passengers relax while someone else drives!
quests.funFact: A bus can carry dozens of passengers all traveling together to their own destination!

quests.instruction: Which person fixes engines and repairs vehicles that are broken?
quests.question: Mechanic
quests.hint: Think about the person in a garage using tools to fix a car that will not start.
quests.explanation: A mechanic is a person who repairs vehicles. Mechanics use tools to fix engines and other parts!
quests.funFact: A skilled mechanic can often figure out exactly what is wrong just by listening to an engine!

quests.instruction: Which person helps passengers and keeps everyone safe and comfortable on an airplane?
quests.question: Flight Attendant
quests.hint: Think about the person who greets you, shows safety instructions, and serves snacks on a flight.
quests.explanation: A flight attendant is a person who helps passengers on a flight. Flight attendants keep everyone safe and comfortable!
quests.funFact: A flight attendant learns exactly what to do to help everyone in almost any kind of emergency!

quests.instruction: Which person works on a ship, helping to sail and care for it?
quests.question: Sailor
quests.hint: Think about the person who climbs, ties knots, and helps steer while working aboard a ship.
quests.explanation: A sailor is a person who works on a ship. Sailors help sail, steer, and take care of a ship!
quests.funFact: Sailors learn many special knots to help tie ropes safely and quickly on board!

quests.instruction: Which person rides a bicycle to get where they need to go?
quests.question: Cyclist
quests.hint: Think about the person pedaling along a bike lane, wearing a helmet for safety.
quests.explanation: A cyclist is a person who rides a bicycle. Cyclists pedal to travel around town or exercise!
quests.funFact: Many cyclists wear a helmet and bright clothing to help stay extra safe and visible!

quests.instruction: Which person travels the same route to work or school every single day?
quests.question: Commuter
quests.hint: Think about the person who takes the very same train or bus to work each morning.
quests.explanation: A commuter is a person who travels the same route regularly. Commuters often ride a train or bus to work!
quests.funFact: Many commuters read, listen to music, or nap during their daily trip to work!

quests.instruction: Which person directs cars and helps keep busy roads running safely?
quests.question: Traffic Officer
quests.hint: Think about the person standing in the middle of a busy intersection, waving cars through with their hands.
quests.explanation: A traffic officer is a person who directs cars safely. Traffic officers help keep busy roads running smoothly!
quests.funFact: A traffic officer uses clear hand signals so every driver can understand exactly what to do!

quests.instruction: Which person helps children safely cross the street near a school?
quests.question: Crossing Guard
quests.hint: Think about the person holding a stop sign, helping children walk safely across the street to school.
quests.explanation: A crossing guard is a person who helps children cross safely. Crossing guards work near busy school streets!
quests.funFact: A crossing guard's bright vest and stop sign help every driver notice them from far away!

quests.instruction: Which person guides airplanes safely so they never come too close together in the sky?
quests.question: Air Traffic Controller
quests.hint: Think about the person in a tall tower watching radar screens to guide many airplanes safely.
quests.explanation: An air traffic controller is a person who guides airplanes safely. Controllers watch radar to keep planes apart!
quests.funFact: An air traffic controller can guide dozens of flights safely at the very same busy time!

quests.instruction: Which person sits beside the pilot and helps fly the airplane?
quests.question: Co-Pilot
quests.hint: Think about the second person in the cockpit, helping the pilot fly and check instruments.
quests.explanation: A co-pilot is a person who helps fly a plane. Co-pilots assist the pilot throughout the whole flight!
quests.funFact: A co-pilot is fully trained to safely fly and even land the plane if it were ever needed!

quests.instruction: Which person plans the route and makes sure a ship or plane stays on the right path?
quests.question: Navigator
quests.hint: Think about the person studying maps and charts to keep a ship traveling exactly the right way.
quests.explanation: A navigator is a person who plans a route. Navigators help keep a ship or plane on the right path!
quests.funFact: Navigators once used the stars in the night sky to help guide ships across the open ocean!

quests.instruction: Which person operates the controls at the very front of a train?
quests.question: Engineer
quests.hint: Think about the person sitting at the very front of a train, controlling its speed the whole trip.
quests.explanation: An engineer is a person who operates a train's controls. Engineers sit at the front to drive the whole train!
quests.funFact: A train engineer must watch the tracks very carefully to keep every single passenger safe!

quests.instruction: Which person helps take care of passengers aboard a ship or plane?
quests.question: Steward
quests.hint: Think about the person who brings meals and answers questions to help passengers feel comfortable.
quests.explanation: A steward is a person who helps take care of passengers. Stewards work aboard ships and planes!
quests.funFact: A steward often greets passengers with a warm smile as soon as they step aboard!

quests.instruction: Which person loads and unloads cargo from ships at a busy port?
quests.question: Dock Worker
quests.hint: Think about the person using cranes and forklifts to move heavy boxes on and off a giant ship.
quests.explanation: A dock worker is a person who loads and unloads ships. Dock workers keep goods moving at a busy port!
quests.funFact: Dock workers use huge cranes to lift shipping containers that weigh many tons each!

quests.instruction: Which person loads and unloads passengers' suitcases at the airport?
quests.question: Baggage Handler
quests.hint: Think about the person working outside near the plane, carefully loading suitcases into the cargo hold.
quests.explanation: A baggage handler is a person who loads suitcases at the airport. Baggage handlers work quickly and carefully!
quests.funFact: A baggage handler might load hundreds of suitcases onto a single busy flight!

quests.instruction: Which person collects a small fee from drivers at a toll booth?
quests.question: Toll Collector
quests.hint: Think about the person sitting inside a small booth on the highway, collecting coins from passing drivers.
quests.explanation: A toll collector is a person who collects fees at a toll booth. Toll collectors help drivers pay quickly!
quests.funFact: Many toll booths now use automatic scanners instead of a toll collector to make traffic move faster!

quests.instruction: Which person is hired to drive someone else around in a fancy car?
quests.question: Chauffeur
quests.hint: Think about the person in a smart uniform who drives a fancy car for someone else.
quests.explanation: A chauffeur is a person hired to drive someone else. Chauffeurs often drive fancy cars or limousines!
quests.funFact: A chauffeur is trained to drive extra smoothly so every ride feels comfortable and calm!

quests.instruction: Which person drives a big truck to deliver goods over long distances?
quests.question: Trucker
quests.hint: Think about the person who drives for many hours, delivering goods across the whole country.
quests.explanation: A trucker is a person who drives a big truck. Truckers deliver goods over long distances!
quests.funFact: A trucker's big truck can carry enough goods to fill an entire small store!

quests.instruction: Which person travels on a bicycle, motorcycle, or horse?
quests.question: Rider
quests.hint: Think about the person sitting on top of a bike or motorcycle as it moves along.
quests.explanation: A rider is a person who travels on a bicycle, motorcycle, or horse. Riders balance carefully as they move!
quests.funFact: A skilled rider learns to keep perfect balance, even while turning corners quickly!

quests.instruction: Which person drives a car along the road?
quests.question: Motorist
quests.hint: Think about another simple word for someone driving their own car on a trip.
quests.explanation: A motorist is a person who drives a car. Motorists follow road signs and rules to stay safe!
quests.funFact: Motorist is just another friendly word people use for someone driving a car!

quests.instruction: Which person travels on foot, walking instead of riding in a vehicle?
quests.question: Pedestrian
quests.hint: Think about the person walking along the sidewalk, not riding in any car or bus at all.
quests.explanation: A pedestrian is a person who travels on foot. Pedestrians walk along sidewalks and use crosswalks!
quests.funFact: Pedestrians should always use a crosswalk and look both ways before crossing a busy street!

quests.instruction: Which person stands by the road, hoping a passing driver will offer them a free ride?
quests.question: Hitchhiker
quests.hint: Think about the person standing near a road holding out their thumb, hoping for a ride from a stranger.
quests.explanation: A hitchhiker is a person who asks passing drivers for a ride. Hitchhikers often hold out their thumb!
quests.funFact: Long ago, hitchhiking was a common way that travelers got around from town to town!

quests.instruction: Which person checks that every passenger on a train has paid for a valid ticket?
quests.question: Ticket Inspector
quests.hint: Think about the person walking through a train car, checking that every rider has a real ticket.
quests.explanation: A ticket inspector is a person who checks tickets on a train. Ticket inspectors make sure every ride is paid for!
quests.funFact: A ticket inspector often uses a small handheld device to quickly scan each ticket!

quests.instruction: Which team of workers prepares an airplane on the ground before it takes off?
quests.question: Ground Crew
quests.hint: Think about the workers outside an airplane, loading bags and checking everything before it flies.
quests.explanation: A ground crew is a team that prepares a plane on the ground. Ground crews check and load a plane before takeoff!
quests.funFact: A busy ground crew can prepare a whole airplane for its next flight in less than an hour!

quests.instruction: Which crew member helps with the everyday jobs needed to keep a ship running?
quests.question: Deckhand
quests.hint: Think about the crew member tying ropes and cleaning the deck to help keep the whole ship running.
quests.explanation: A deckhand is a crew member who helps with everyday ship jobs. Deckhands assist with ropes and general upkeep!
quests.funFact: Many experienced captains started their careers working as a deckhand on a ship!

quests.instruction: Which crew member is second in command on a ship, right after the captain?
quests.question: First Mate
quests.hint: Think about the crew member who helps run the ship and takes charge whenever the captain is away.
quests.explanation: A first mate is second in command on a ship. First mates help the captain run the ship smoothly!
quests.funFact: If a captain cannot lead for any reason, the first mate is ready to take over right away!
